card.name: Small words in historical crime narratives
card.fires_on: Small linking words, quote marks or punctuation in narrative history or religious prose, often just before a noun about punishment, trial, goods or an official title. The words are not specific; the setting is crime, arrest or social-history text.

modes.label: Links before trial or punishment
modes.description: A preposition or verb right before a word like trial, punishment or a weapon in an arrest story.

modes.description: A quote mark before a quoted title or phrase in historical or biblical writing.

modes.label: Possessive or 'of' before a noun
modes.description: A word such as his or of that leads into a noun phrase about goods or a case.
